retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1970s graphic style featuring a central silhouette subject overlaid on a simplified, flat-color world map with ultra-heavy display typography.
triggerTerms: high contrast black silhouette over globe
excludeWhen: delicate or thin typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, high-contrast black silhouette of two hands meeting in a gesture of unity, positioned in front of a large, circular, simplified world map rendered in flat, vibrant primary and secondary colors. The composition is framed by a clean white border with heavy, blocky typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Black silhouette foreground against vibrant map background
Circular globe centered within a square frame
Ultra-bold header text balanced by white negative space at the top
Simplified continental shapes with thin white outlines
coreInvariants: High-contrast black silhouette with minimal internal detail
Flat, non-gradient color fields for the map
White border or margin around the central circular element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large black hands in the lower-center foreground, scaled to occupy approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular globe acts as the primary visual anchor, centered horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the heavy top header, move down to the central silhouette, and then expand outward to the colorful map.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white negative space at the top and bottom corners of the square frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black for the primary silhouette and typography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright blue for oceans and vibrant green for landmasses.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red for specific continental highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation colors against a stark black and white foundation.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, condensed, high-contrast sans-serif or slab-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and U characters have almost no internal counter space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy weight for all display text to maintain impact.
graphicDevices: Thin white outlines around map continents
Circular clipping mask for the map

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square composition with a white border. In the center, place a large circular globe with flat, vibrant blue oceans, green continents, and orange-red highlights. Over the globe, place a high-contrast black silhouette of two hands meeting in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of ultra-bold, condensed black display text at the top, centered within the white margin.

verificationChecks: Is the silhouette pure black with no gradients?
Is the typography extremely heavy and condensed?
Are the map colors flat and vibrant?
Is there a clear white border around the circular element?

mustRedesign: Specific continental shapes to avoid direct copy
Specific hand gestures to avoid direct copy
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite extreme weight
Check that the silhouette does not blend into the map colors
Verify the circular shape is perfectly centered
Confirm the white border is consistent on all sides
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Silhouette] + [Flat Color Circular Map] + [Ultra-Bold Condensed Header] + [White Margin Frame].
